Subject: Task: Implement forceStatusChange API
Description:
Create an API endpoint for supervisors to force an agent's status.

# Low-Level Design (LLD)
## Endpoint
`POST /api/v1/supervisor/agents/:id/status`

## Logic
1. Validate supervisor permissions
2. Update agent status in Redis/DB
3. Emit `agent:status_changed` event via WebSocket to the agent's client
